brief:
Palestinian football has resumed competitive play after nearly three years with the Martyrs' World Cup tournament, Al Jazeera English reported. The event represents the sport's restart in Palestinian territories following prolonged disruption caused by military restrictions and conflict.

Organizers and players view the competition as an assertion of Palestinian resilience and continuity. Participants emphasized their determination to maintain social and athletic traditions despite ongoing external pressures.
dek: The Martyrs’ World Cup brings Palestinian football back after nearly three years, despite military restrictions.
title: Palestinian Football Returns With Martyrs' World Cup Tournament
